records.text: Boiler Feed Pump 101 showed high vibration and bearing temperature following low suction pressure during load ramps. Root cause was a 60 percent blocked suction strainer. The strainer was cleaned and NPSH margin restored; vibration returned to 2.1 mm/s. Lesson: trend strainer differential pressure and clean proactively above 0.35 bar.

Recurring low suction pressure every three to five days on Boiler Feed Pump 101 with normal deaerator level. The minimum-flow recirculation valve FV-101 was found sticking at 20 percent open. The positioner was recalibrated. Lesson: stroke-test the recirculation valve when low suction pressure recurs at low load.

Mechanical seal leak on Boiler Feed Pump 101 after a cavitation episode. The seal was replaced under permit following SAF-003. Root cause: dry-running damage of the seal faces from cavitation. Lesson: address cavitation before the seal is damaged.

records.section: K-501 surge from slow anti-surge valve (INC-1008)
records.text: Gas Compressor K-501 surged three times in 12 hours during feed gas reduction. Anti-surge valve UV-501 stroke time was 9 seconds against a 2 second specification. The actuator solenoid was replaced. Lesson: perform a stroke test per KA-0057 after repeated surge.

Weekly surge on K-501 was traced to a surge control margin of 5 percent. The margin was increased to 10 percent and controller gains were retuned with the OEM. Drive motor M-501 overcurrent alarms during surge stopped after retuning.
Recycle Compressor K-502 vibration 7.8 mm/s at 1x and 2x running speed. Laser alignment corrected coupling shims; vibration reduced to 2.4 mm/s.
